mean_cn: n.游行；检阅；  v.游行，（使）列队行进；游行，(使)列队行进；展览
mean_en: to walk somewhere in a formal group of people, in order to celebrate or protest about something; to walk around in a way that makes other people notice you; to show somebody/something in public so that people can see them/it; to come together, or to bring soldiers together, in order to march in front of other people
sentence: The New Year parade in Chinatown is always a popular event.
sentence_trans: 在唐人街举办的新年大游行总是一项受人欢迎的活动。
